name: agentchat-codex
description: Connect existing Codex and Claude Code sessions through a bounded AgentChat bridge.

interface.shortDescription: Connect Codex and Claude Code with AgentChat
interface.longDescription: Instruction and safety guidance for binding a local AgentChat bridge to one Codex task. The bridge owns long-polling and delivery; this plugin does not run a daemon or grant remote messages additional permissions.
defaultPrompt: Use $agentchat to configure passive AgentChat delivery.
Use $agentchat to inspect a received AgentChat file safely.
Use $agentchat to troubleshoot the local bridge.
